title: Heritage editorial and place treatment
changes: The heritage landing surface now shares the Wave 7 editorial canvas and restrained gold intro rule with History.
Heritage place cards, image captions and source actions now form a coherent place-first presentation while retaining original provenance.
The map band and selected-collection context use semantic muted/accent surfaces without changing map selection behavior.
Thematic collections and self-guided routes use distinct card treatments so routes remain conceptually separate from places.
Place, source, collection-history and route-stop links now meet the 44px interaction baseline.
The final handoff to History is visually integrated instead of reading as an isolated card.
Hover image/card motion respects reduced-motion preferences.
preserved: Canonical Place Registry ownership and place IDs
Heritage map view controls and aria-pressed state
Map path behavior for walking routes
Primary media alt text, source URL, credit, license and license URL
Collection and walking-route IDs and anchors
Responsive two-column place grid and map layout markers required by the Wave 5 heritage closure audit
